svg.title: Figure 13. The wiring budget of the two sides
svg.desc: Figure 13. A dot chart of 36 left-right pairs of neuropils in two columns, each dot the natural logarithm of the left side's wire over the right side's, against a line at zero. Most pairs lie within 0.5 of zero; the median pair differs by a factor of 1.13 and the widest, LA, by 13.5 in favour of the right. Below, the mean of the 36 ratios, −0.124, sits inside the central 95% of 1000 sign flips of the same ratios (z = −1.49, two-sided p = 0.109), so there is no side bias in the wiring budget that this test can separate from chance.
